articles.title: Cantor PC Silva movimenta a própria engrenagem no show que gera o álbum ao vivo autoral 'Eu vou ganhar o mundo' | G1
articles.body:
PC Silva lança o álbum 'Eu vou ganhar o mundo – Ao vivo', gravado em show do artista em Olinda (PE) — Foto: Qorpo | Kristopher Kim / Divulgação

♬ Em “tempo de marés agitadas e poucas certezas”, como ressalta texto da escritora Ezter Liu ouvido na abertura do álbum ao vivo lançado por PC Silva na quinta-feira, 19 de novembro, esse artista pernambucano tem cumprido o papel de existir (e resistir) na turbulência do mundo, movimentando a própria engrenagem.

Gravado em show apresentado em 12 de setembro no Alma Arte Café, em Olinda (PE), o álbum “Eu vou ganhar o mundo – Ao vivo” condensa em 15 faixas os 15 anos da trajetória autoral de Paulo César Silva, artista que, de 2011 a 2016, planou na renovada cena musical de Pernambuco como integrante da Bandavoou.

Alavancado pela inédita música-título “Eu vou ganhar o mundo”, o álbum oferece bom resumo da produção autoral de PC Silva na discografia solo iniciada em abril de 2020 com o single “Meu amorzim”, amostra inicial do primeiro álbum do artista, “Amor, saudade e tempo” (2020).

Do repertório autoral desse álbum, o cantor rebobina músicas como “Adeus, obrigado e disponha”, “Boomerang”, “Ciclone” e “Freegells”, além da já mencionada “Meu amorzin”. Do segundo álbum solo, “Me dê notícias do universo” (2024), PC Silva dá voz a canções como “Arrodeio”, “De Nova Orleans até Taperoá”, “Lambada exuberante” – parceria do artista com Zeca Baleiro – e “Sinto que estou bem”.

Novidade, mas somente na voz de PC, é “Estranha toada” (2019), música que ele compôs com Martins – intérprete da gravação original – e que Ney Matogrosso regravou no álbum “Nu com a minha música” (2021).

O álbum “Eu vou ganhar o mundo – Ao vivo” é o registro fonográfico que perpetua turnê que levou PC Silva a fazer 22 shows por 21 cidades do Brasil e de Portugal ao longo de seis meses deste ano de 2026.

Fazendo o que prega Ezter Liu no texto que abre o álbum ao vivo originado da turnê, PC Silva movimentou a própria engrenagem, captando recursos para realizar e eternizar por vias independentes esse show autoral de voz e violão que prova a existência do artista em meio à turbulência do mundo.

articles.title: Ranking the top six 'Grand Theft Auto VI' in-game radio stations, from V-Rock to Vice City FM
articles.summary: "Grand Theft Auto VI" packs 22 radio stations, and this ranking crowns V-Rock No. 1, with Emotion 98.3 yacht rock and Vice City FM's 80s vibes close behind.
articles.body: If you’ve played even five minutes of "Grand Theft Auto VI" since its release, you know just how immersive this video game is. There are miles of swamps and beaches to explore, realistic NPC interactions and I even made an entire article about how realistic the game’s version of South Florida is when compared to its real-life counterpart. But one mechanic that has been included in the new game that’s been around since the early days of the series are the radio stations, and "GTA VI" has the most diverse radio dial yet. REDDIT'S BIRDING COMMUNITY GOES WILD AS UNIQUE 'GRAND THEFT AUTO 6' FEATURE COMES TO LIGHT All in all, there are 22 unique radio stations in the game, and each of them offers a different soundtrack to your wheeling and stealing as you traverse through Leonida. Being a huge fan of the series and music in general, I thought it would be fun to rank my six favorite "GTA VI" radio stations. This wasn’t easy, as there are a ton of great stations to choose from, and I even had to omit a few that I really liked (sorry, Back Country Radio). With that said, let’s rank the best that "GTA VI" has to offer in the form of music. 6. Flash FM By virtue of hitting the "quantity over quality" metrics, Flash FM sneaks its way onto the list at number six. Don't get me wrong, there are heaps of awful songs on this station, but there are some gems in there too. Echosmith, Foster The People, Gwen Stefani, and MGMT will have Millennials bobbing their heads as they commit vehicular homicide (in the game), and newcomers like Ella Langley and Addison Rae offer enough to be passable cruising songs when there's nothing else on. Flash FM isn't the stalwart it was back in the '80s for "Grand Theft Auto: Vice City," but there is enough fun to be had here for this station to find its way into the rotation. 5. Dirty South Classics This one might be a bit of a nostalgia pick for me, but I don't care. Having grown up and gone to high school in South Florida, a lot of the songs on this station were popular right around the time my life was centered around algebra tests and getting rejected by chicks, so playing a game where I can drive around a virtual representation of my hometown while blaring rap songs that were popular 15 years ago is an auto win. If you're into 2000s and 2010s rap, you'll probably have your radio dial locked on Dirty South Classics, with heavy hitters like Lil Wayne, Outkast, Drake, Rick Ross and even Jay Z being well represented here. There is no better feeling than cruising Miami Beach at night listening to "No Lie" by 2Chainz, and it's even cooler when that is also a core memory from your adolescence, minus the cocaine and dead hookers. 4. Vice City FM Now we are getting into rarified air, and Vice City FM begins a string of stations with way more good than bad on them. For those of you who wanted the '80s vibes of "Vice City" to carry over to the new game, you're in luck. MIAMI HEAT UNVEIL VICE CITY COURT FOR 'GRAND THEFT AUTO VI'-THEMED CLASH WITH MILWAUKEE BUCKS Vice City FM is a carryover from the old Playstation 2 game, and the songs you'll find on here will have you thinking you hopped in a DeLorean and landed in 1986. Genesis, Culture Club, Lionel Richie, Billy Idol, The Cars and so much more, you'll be pulling out the AquaNet and legwarmers before your first hour of gameplay. The neon lights of South Florida mesh perfectly with the 80s vibes, and this station makes for a cool nighttime drive soundtrack. For an added bonus, Weird Al Yankovic is one of the in-game DJs, which I thought was a nice touch. 3. The Chamber 106.6 Metal, metal and more metal. That's what you're going to find on The Chamber. While I'm partial to the older stuff, this station has a great mix of classic and newer metal to bridge the generational gap for headbangers. If you're a spiritual Boomer like me, you'll be happy to know acts like Iron Maiden, Judas Priest, Megadeth and, of course, Metallica are littered all over The Chamber. New-school metal disciples will be pleased to hear the likes of Linkin Park, System of a Down, Tool and Sepultura mixed in. Committing virtual crimes is so much more fun when it's set to the brutal riffing and blistering solos of Judas Priest's "Freewheel Burning," but don't just take my word for it, try it yourself. And hey, the station is hosted by Slayer's Tom Araya and Kerry King, so you know it's curated by two legends. 2. Emotion 98.3 Can you name a better combination than the sun-soaked streets of South Florida and some soothing yacht rock? Of course you can't, which is why Emotion 98.3 is sitting in the silver medal spot for "GTA VI" radio stations. Emotion makes its triumphant return as one of the stations featured in "GTA: Vice City," and its setlist will have you looking for the nearest super yacht to steal so that you can enjoy the songs properly. You want soft rock? How does Ace, Chicago, The Doobie Brothers, and Bruce Hornsby sound? And that's just the tip of the iceberg. I spent my entire life being serenaded by these guys while navigating the intracoastal waterways of South Florida, and now I get to do it in a video game. Life sure is sweet sometimes! 1. V-Rock It was never going to be anything else. If you played "GTA: Vice City," you know how legendary this station was. Well, it's back and better than ever, featuring a wide range of classic rock artists that offer the best company on any long drive around Leonida. There are too many bangers to even count, but I'll try: Def Leppard, AC/DC, Aerosmith, Dire Straits, Foreigner, Blue Oyster Cult, Motley Crue, Styx, and ZZ Top, just to name a few. Seriously, I haven't even mentioned another half dozen artists who rank as some of my favorites of all time. Oh, and they have Van Halen, too. In case I needed to nerd out any more than I already am. I also love how they included several Tom Petty songs, given his connection to the Sunshine State. Finally, the station is hosted by Lindsey Buckingham of Fleetwood Mac fame and Michael Freaking McDonald. articles.title: Miley Cyrus marries Maxx Morando in intimate Palm Springs wedding
articles.summary: The lavish nuptials come nearly a year after Page Six confirmed the two were engaged.
articles.body:
Cue the flowers … Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando are married!

The singer and her rocker beau tied the knot in a lavish wedding ceremony held at a private residence in Palm Springs, California, on Saturday. ( Entertainment Tonight was the first to report the news.)

Miley's parents, dad Billy Ray Cyrus and mom Tish Cyrus, were present for the nuptials.

They were also joined by their respective partners, Elizabeth Hurley — who recently got engaged to Billy Ray — and Dominic Purcell — whom Tish married in 2023 .

Flaming Lips frontman Wayne Coyne, with whom Miley is close friends and a frequent collaborator, officiated the ceremony.

A staggering number of white flowers were pictured being delivered to the venue Saturday as final preparations for the nuptials were being made.

The news comes a day after the happy couple was spotted at their wedding rehearsal dinner — wearing black and walking hand in hand .

A pair of Instagram uploads shared by Tish's stepdaughter, Lily-Rose Purcell, revealed that delicacies including filet mignon, sherry cappuccino, and hazelnut crème brûlée were on the menu .

The menu was inscribed with their first initials, "M + M," and the date of the event, "11.20.2026."

Just last month, Cyrus appeared to hint at the nuptials while performing at the Hollywood Bowl .

During her Oct. 18 show at the iconic venue in Los Angeles, the "Flowers" singer, 33, brought out Morando, 28, as a special guest. He played drums while she belted out her song "Let's Get Married" (from her new "Bass Persuades" album) during the encore.

Page Six was at the show and witnessed the two appearing head over heels while performing the romantic track together. As the song wrapped, Cyrus adorably kissed her fiancé before walking off stage.

As previously reported, Cyrus and Morando got engaged in Kyoto, Japan, in late 2025, after four years of dating.

"We went to Tokyo first for a couple days, and then on to Kyoto. I think she had a sense that it was coming, so I was waiting until the very last moment of the very last day [of our trip] to throw her off the scent as much as I could," Morando told Wonderland magazine in July, while reflecting on his proposal.

"We took a walk around the hotel grounds. There was this little outer garden … we walked in, and it was a little dead end, this beautiful Japanese forest-y situation. She was taking videos and was turned away. That's when I got on one knee and tapped her on the shoulder."

The musician popped the question to the former "Hannah Montana" star with a 14-karat gold creation by celebrity-loved jewelry designer Jacquie Aiche.

The sparkler was front and center as Cyrus walked the red carpet for the "Avatar: Fire and Ash" premiere in Los Angeles last December with Morando by her side.

"Me and Max have been together for four years, and it's very obvious the drastic amount of growth that I've had in those four years … a lot of that is because I have a great partner," she later gushed during a guest appearance on "Good Morning America," after Page Six exclusively confirmed the engagement .

"You just want to dream the biggest you can, and you want to have someone by your side that always tells you can do it."

Cyrus first spoke about her romance with the Liily drummer in a 2023 interview with British Vogue .

"We got put on a blind date. Well, it was blind for me and not really for him," she recalled, revealing they started dating "a couple of summers" ago at the time. "I thought, 'The worst that can happen is I leave.'"

In the years since then, the two have supported each other at several high-profile events, where they haven't been shy about packing on the PDA. They've also gushed over their love in various interviews and on social media.

"I ended up with a person who means a lot to me and treats me really well and respects me," Cyrus said in a September 2025 interview with the Cut . "My man's hot as hell."

As for how Cyrus knew Morando was "the one" for her?

"There's a whole list of things. I can't read you my vows," she joked to Apple Music's Zane Lowe in September 2025. "But the No. 1 thing I think that I noticed from the beginning was we talked about the kind of wisdom of a child and just, like, their unknowing is what makes them so brilliant. That's what I love about Maxx the most."

"This part of my life is something I've always wanted," she added of their relationship. "And this is what I hope other people get to have, what I have. I don't know if everybody gets to find their Maxx."

Miley — who is the daughter of country singer Billy Ray Cyrus and Tish Cyrus — was previously married to actor Liam Hemsworth.

The two tied the knot in 2018 but called it quits less than a year later.

The "Hunger Games" star has since moved on with model Gabriella Brooks. The two have been engaged since September 2025.

articles.body: Suriya's 'Scene', directed by Jithu Madhavan, recorded an improvement in its box office performance on Saturday, November 21. The movie collected Rs 1.35 cr in India net earnings on Day 16, with 731 shows across its Tamil and Telugu versions. The Tamil version accounted for Rs 1.10 cr from 499 shows, while the Telugu version added Rs 25 lakh through 232 shows.According to Sacnilk reports, the latest day's collection was 75.3% higher than Friday's Rs 77 lakh. The film's cumulative India net collection has now reached Rs 149.07 cr, while its domestic gross stands at Rs 173.17 cr. Its highest single-day collection remains the Rs 23.65 cr recorded on Day 3.The overseas market added Rs 25 lakh on Saturday, taking the cumulative overseas gross to Rs 89.25 cr. This pushed the worldwide gross to Rs 262.42 cr after 16 days in theatres. The movie is now progressing towards the Rs 300 cr worldwide milestone.'Scene' records a Saturday recovery after second-week declineThe film's weekly figures show a considerable slowdown after its opening week. Between Days 1 and 7, 'Scene' earned Rs 111.70 cr in India net collections and Rs 129.75 cr in gross collections.The second week, covering Days 8 to 14, brought in Rs 35.25 cr net and Rs 40.95 cr gross. This represented a 68.4% decline from the first week's business. During the third week, the movie collected Rs 2.12 cr net and Rs 2.47 cr gross across Days 15 and 16.The film has recorded 68,513 shows during its 16-day theatrical run. Saturday saw an estimated 102,492 tickets sold, taking the cumulative ticket sales to 11,333,480.Tamil version accounts for nearly 80% of India net collectionThe Tamil version continues to lead the domestic box office contribution. It has earned Rs 119.12 cr, accounting for 79.9% of the total India net collection. The Telugu version has contributed Rs 29.95 cr, making up the remaining 20.1%.The difference was also visible in Saturday's occupancy figures. The Tamil version recorded 54% occupancy across 499 shows, while the Telugu version registered 31% from 232 shows. The gap between them stood at 23 percentage points.The Tamil 2D version registered an overall occupancy of 64.62% on Day 16. Its morning shows recorded 35.31%, while afternoon and evening screenings registered 56.38% and 46.38%, respectively. Night shows saw the highest occupancy at 68%.The Telugu 2D version reported an overall occupancy of 24.43%. Morning shows registered 21.30%, followed by 20.40% in the afternoon. Evening occupancy stood at 18.80%, while night screenings recorded 22.90%.The film's domestic gross accounts for 66% of its worldwide earnings, with overseas markets contributing the remaining 34%. The international business has therefore remained an important part of its overall box office performance.'Mookuthi Amman 2' earns Rs 24.80 cr worldwideMeanwhile, Nayanthara's 'Mookuthi Amman 2' has recorded a worldwide gross of Rs 24.80 cr after 16 days in theatres. The figures, reported through November 21, 2026, include an India net collection of Rs 21.52 cr. Its India gross also stands at Rs 24.80 cr, while no overseas collection has been reported.The movie earned Rs 2 lakh on Day 16, registering a 100% increase over its previous day's collection. Its worldwide total remains considerably lower than the figure achieved by 'Scene' over the same 16-day period. articles.body: Amal Neerad's 'Bachelor Party D'eux', starring Naslen, Soubin Shahir, Sreenath Bhasi, Tovino Thomas and Kunchacko Boban, continued to experience a slowdown at the box office on Saturday. The Malayalam film collected Rs 37 lakh net in India on its third day, registering a 35.1% decline from Friday. Its three-day domestic earnings have reached Rs 3.49 cr net, with the gross collection standing at Rs 4.11 cr. The film's Saturday performance also marked a considerable drop from its opening-day business. It recorded an average of approximately Rs 4,579 per show across its theatrical screenings.'Bachelor Party D'eux' records another decline on SaturdayAccording to Sacnilk, the film opened with a promising performance on Thursday but could not maintain the same momentum over the following two days. Its Friday earnings dropped by 77.6% compared with the opening day. Saturday brought a further decline, although the rate of fall was less severe than the previous day's.The film collected Rs 37 lakh net from 808 shows on Saturday. Its overall occupancy for the day stood at 14%, while the cumulative footfall reached 2,51,690. The latest figures indicate that the movie is yet to regain the momentum witnessed during its opening-day run.The Malayalam version continues to account for almost the entire domestic box-office business of 'Bachelor Party D'eux'. It has contributed Rs 3.44 cr, representing 98.6% of the film's India net collections. The Telugu version has added Rs 5 lakh, accounting for the remaining 1.4%.The Malayalam 2D version recorded an overall occupancy of 13.59% on Saturday. Night screenings registered the highest occupancy at 21%, followed by evening shows at 12.5%. Afternoon screenings recorded 10.25%, while morning shows reported 5.17%. The figures indicate that the movie attracted a relatively better audience during the later screenings.Night shows lead Saturday occupancyDespite the overall decline in collections, night shows performed better than the other time slots. Their occupancy was considerably higher than the morning and afternoon figures. However, the overall response remained modest, with the film recording an average occupancy below 15% across its Saturday screenings.'Bougainvillea' had a stronger third-day performanceAmal Neerad's previous directorial venture, 'Bougainvillea', performed considerably better at the same stage of its theatrical run. Its third-day performance included 1,621 shows and an overall occupancy of 37%.'Bachelor Party D'eux' is presented as a spiritual successor to Amal Neerad's 2012 Malayalam film 'Bachelor Party'. articles.title: Ronny Hallin, who played Maxine on 'Laverne & Shirley,' dies at 88 after decades in television: report
articles.summary: Ronny Hallin, sister of Garry Marshall and Penny Marshall, died at 88 after a career behind hit sitcoms like "Happy Days" and "Mork & Mindy."
articles.body: Ronny Hallin, the actress who played Maxine on "Laverne & Shirley," has died. She was 88. Ronny's daughter, Penny Hallin, told Deadline that she "passed away peacefully at home" on Oct. 27. Ronny, born Ronny Marshall, was a famous television producer, casting coordinator, and actress. articles.summary: Tallulah Willis recently took to her social media to share a glimpse of how she has been spending time with her father, Bruce Willis.
articles.body: Tallulah Willis recently took to her social media to share a glimpse of how she has been spending time with her father, Bruce Willis. The 32-year-old, along with the entire Willis family, has been quite open about the ‘Die Hard’ star’s dementia diagnosis and how they all cope with and manage the disease while spending time with the star.Tallulah Willis shares new photos with Bruce WillisIn her latest post on Instagram, shared on November 21, Tallulah shared brand new photos of her and the ‘Die Hard’ star, who is 71 now, holding hands while they sat on an outside porch together. The two were surrounded by greenery as they sat together on the swinging bench while she smiled at her father. She shared the photo along with a ‘cool’ emoji, as well as a smiley face emoji wearing sunglasses.In the photo, Willis wore a pair of grey pants, a cardigan, and a polo shirt while holding onto his daughter’s hand, who opted to wear blue jeans and a red sweater.Fans react to the new photos of Bruce WillisThe comment section was soon flooded with people sharing their well-wishes for the actor and his family. One person posted, “Give him a hug from us!!!" while another shared, “Love you, Bruce. Best wishes.” A third social media user commented, “Such a long, hard goodbye…grief beyond what’s hard to comprehend. But we find our strength somehow.”Another netizen shared their love for the actor and wrote, “We love you, Bruce; may every rainbow shower you," while another comment under Tallulah’s post read, “Beautiful picture. I did this with my dad. My sister and I took care of him every day. It’s a terrible disease.” Many people also reached out and commented that they are keeping the 71-year-old actor in their thoughts and prayers every day.Earlier in August, Tallulah tied the knot with her longtime partner and musician, Justin Acee. Vogue reported that the two got married in Sun Valley, Idaho, and were surrounded by close friends and family members. Bruce also attended the wedding ceremony, with his daughter sharing glimpses of him at the celebration. In the photo, Bruce was seen smiling at his daughter and had his arm wrapped around her while her new husband held his other hand.Bruce has been suffering from frontotemporal dementia (FTD) for years now and has since stepped away from acting. According to Cleveland Clinic, FTD is a “progressive brain disease. This means it gets worse over time as parts of your brain stop working. Depending on where it starts, it can affect your behaviour, movement, and ability to speak and understand others. There isn’t a cure, but your provider can help you manage symptoms. Symptoms target your behaviour, movement, personality, and/or language. It’s a progressive disorder. This means that symptoms get worse over time.”Since then, his wife and his daughters have become his primary caregivers. In August, while talking about taking care of her partner on ABC’s special, ‘Emma & Bruce Willis: The Unexpected Journey,' Emma Heming Willis shared that she had shifted the actor into a separate one-story home, away from his family but with round-the-clock care available for him, as a part of his dementia treatment. articles.title: The Pennsylvania farm behind a White House Thanksgiving turkey tradition
articles.summary: For more than six decades, Jaindl Farms in Orefield, Pennsylvania, has supplied turkeys to presidents for the White House Thanksgiving meal. FOX's Pete Cuddihy visits the family-owned farm behind the presidential tradition.
articles.body: Every Thanksgiving table has its traditions: Stuffing, mashed potatoes, cranberry sauce — and, of course, the turkey. For more than six decades, one Pennsylvania farm has played a central role in one of the country's most high-profile Thanksgiving meals: the one served at the White House. Jaindl Farms, a family-owned operation in Orefield, Pennsylvania, has supplied turkeys to U.S. presidents dating back to Dwight D. Eisenhower. BEHIND THE THANKSGIVING TURKEY TRADITION "We supplied every president since '59. There were years that we did not supply the turkey, but every president, every single president at one time or another got our turkey," said David Jaindl, owner of Jaindl Farms. The business dates back to 1933, when Jaindl's father and grandfather started raising turkeys. "My father and grandfather started the business. My father bought five turkeys from my grandfather," Jaindl said. What began with just five turkeys eventually grew into a major operation producing award-winning birds. Then, in 1959, the farm received a special request: two turkeys for the White House. "Eisenhower was the first president to receive the turkey from us in a bag," Jaindl said. PRESIDENTIAL TURKEY PARDON TRADITION The tradition continued through generations of presidents. While Americans may be most familiar with the two turkeys that receive a presidential pardon each Thanksgiving, the White House also receives two additional birds from Jaindl Farms for the holiday meal. THE TWO TURKEYS LUCKY ENOUGH TO BE PARDONED Despite the special delivery to 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue, Jaindl said the turkeys selected for the president are no different from the ones available to customers at the farm. "It's the same turkey. I don't say, 'Look out for the best turkey that comes off the line. Don't do that. Pick two turkeys out and put them in a bag,'" he said. For Jaindl, supplying the White House is a tremendous honor. But after decades of building the family business, what makes him most proud is seeing the next generation carry it forward. "It's very important that my family works with me and other family members so all my children, five children, one girl and four boys, all working the business," he said. And when it comes to what happens to the presidential turkeys after Thanksgiving, there is another tradition. CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP In recent years, Presidents Barack Obama and Donald Trump donated the birds supplied by Jaindl Farms to charity, continuing a holiday tradition of giving back. For the Jaindl family, however, the biggest Thanksgiving tradition may be the one that started nearly a century ago: keeping the farm in the family.

articles.body: Music composer Sam CS has raised his issues on the current trends in music and has called upon young composers to focus more on good music and not just on the trends in music. This is because the music consumers will always appreciate a quality composition. Sam has called on young musicians to experiment with all sorts of music. The music composer has also raised his opinions on the trend of change in the consumption of music and his inability to relate with some music trends.Sam CS praises Anirudh, GV Prakash, and Santhosh NarayananSpeaking about the music of his contemporaries in an interview with Behindwoods, Sam CS praised Anirudh Ravichander, GV Prakash Kumar, and Santhosh Narayanan for their work. He also highlighted the importance of melody and variety in film music. Sharing his request to young composers, he said, "My request to all music directors is to give good music. Audiences will definitely like it. In recent times, I have really enjoyed Anirudh's music. I am also a big fan of GV Prakash's music. I hope he continues to be among the composers who give us good music. He delivers beautiful melodies. Santhosh Narayanan also gives versatile music. Young composers should explore different genres and offer a variety of music to audiences."Sam CS on loud music and the changing taste of audiencesThen the composer explained how, at times, it gets difficult for him to connect with the loud music that is becoming famous nowadays in movie music composition. This is because, due to his upbringing and his liking for melodies, pleasant music has been ingrained in him.Speaking about the change in preferences of audiences, he remarked, “These days youngsters have become familiar with loud music, and composers are composing music according to their likes. However, for me it becomes tough to get used to this style because my childhood was filled with music by AR Rahman and Ilaiyaraaja. People these days say that AR Rahman’s music is old, but Rahman and Ilaiyaraaja are still continuing in the industry. It pains me that these youngsters are not listening to pleasant music. Gradually, I am getting used to current trends even though I don’t like them myself.”Sam CS' latest release 'Sathyavan Savithiri' and his future filmsSam CS is continuing his work on various film projects in different industries. His last film release was 'Sathyavan Savithiri' featuring Keerthy Suresh and Mysskin, which released in theaters on November 20. Directed by Praveen S Vijaay, the courtroom thriller has music composed by Sam CS. Its five-song soundtrack includes 'Rippipee', 'Sakkarai Penne', 'Koodinge' and 'Maayavi'. Sam CS is also working on 'RAPO23', an upcoming project of Ram Pothineni, marking his directorial debut. articles.title: Faisal Malik reveals how he played Kumbhakaran in Ranbir Kapoor's 'Ramayana', saying, 'I had to unlearn traditional acting methods'; calls working with Yash a 'once in a lifetime experience'
articles.summary: Faisal Malik, who plays Kumbhakaran in Nitesh Tiwari's 'Ramayana', said that he had to set aside conventional acting methods for this VFX-heavy epic.
articles.body: Faisal Malik, who plays Kumbhakaran in Nitesh Tiwari's 'Ramayana', said that he had to set aside conventional acting methods for this VFX-heavy epic. Sharing the screen with Yash as Ravana, he described the project as a "once in a lifetime experience".Why he had to unlearn actingAccording to the Hindustan Times report, speaking about the challenge, Faisal Malik said, "This is a highly VFX-driven film and not a normal acting film. So, I had to unlearn traditional acting methods, as there is a certain way to do things, and we were trained for it by the team, which was of utmost importance."Working with Yash in 'Ramayana'Faisal has crucial portions with Yash, mostly in the film's second part. Describing how they were filmed, he said, "Major shooting has been done separately, but I have some critical scenes with him in the second part. We saw Ravana walking on Kumbhakaran's hand to bless him, so that was shot separately, keeping in mind the eye, face, and body movement. We had seen the making videos of Lord of the Rings and Avatar, but here we got to be part of the amazing process. I feel, before and after this, nothing as grand as this will happen in Indian cinema in the near future."The makers told him that the character's sheer size is the main visual draw, so the emphasis was on the body instead of his real face. He added, "Kumbhakaran was the biggest warrior and a demon, so viewers won't see Faisal on screen."Huge team effort behind the scenesFaisal was amazed to see how the process works. He said, "Thousands of people working on a scene, including a foreign crew, is amazing. On one character and scene, so many teams are working together and improvising things for days and months. It's very easy to be critical and say it's AI. But the fact is most people don't understand the difference between CGI and AI."Fans flood social media with reelsThe actor is also thrilled by the audience reaction. He said, "People are tagging me in reels, especially the entry one, with lakhs of views. I have got love for Panchayat, and people made viral reels and memes. But people taking the pain of recording it from the cinema and flooding the Insta feed is very heartening. Bahut pyaar mil raha hai…bhar-bhar kar."Faisal Malik leads the IMDb weekly listFaisal Malik currently holds the No. 1 spot on IMDb's weekly list, with Yash, his on-screen elder brother, right behind at No. 2. The actor is widely recognised for playing Deputy Pradhan Prahlad Cha in the OTT series 'Panchayat'.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: How to follow Qatar Grand Prix on the BBC
articles.summary: All the key BBC coverage details for the Qatar Grand Prix, which takes place from 27 to 29 November.
articles.body:
Round 22 of the 2026 Formula 1 season heads to the Lusail International Circuit for the Qatar Grand Prix, from 27-29 November.

Red Bull's Max Verstappen finished on the top step of the podium in a chaotic Las Vegas Grand Prix which featured 352 overtakes.

The Dutchman was joined on the podium by McLaren's Lando Norris in second and Oscar Piastri in third.

Ferrari missed out on the chance to secure second in the constructors' championship after Charles Leclerc made contact with team-mate Lewis Hamilton.

Lights out for Sunday's 57-lap race is at 16:00 GMT.

Commentary of the weekend will be available across BBC Radio 5 Sports Extra, BBC Sounds and the BBC Sport website and app.

You can also ask your smart speaker to "play 5 Sports Extra", for example.

Make sure to listen to every episode of the Chequered Flag podcast. For the first time this year, the post-race show for every grand prix is available to watch on BBC iPlayer and YouTube.

First practice: 13:30-14:30 - 5 Sports Extra

Second practice: 17:00-18:00 - 5 Sports Extra

Third practice: 14:30-15:30 - Sports Extra 2

Qualifying: 18:00-19:00 - 5 Sports Extra

The early forecast suggest the weather in Lusail will be sunny with a gentle breeze across the three days of track action.

For Sunday's race, which starts at 7pm local time, conditions should be dry with a high temperature of 24C.

The drivers will be limited to 27 laps on a set of tyres for the weekend.

The decision is caused by concern over the integrity of the Pirelli tyres on the high-speed Lusail track, which has a series of demanding, long-duration corners.

It means teams will have to make at least two pit stops during the race.

Pirelli said the limit was longer then last year's 25 laps because of the reduced downforce levels of the 2026 cars compared with 2025.

articles.title: Ferrari boss blames Leclerc for ‘completely unacceptable’ collision
articles.summary: Lewis Hamilton warned team-mate Charles Leclerc to “back the f*** off” before their “completely unacceptable” collision at the Las Vegas Grand Prix engulfed...
articles.body:
Lewis Hamilton warned team-mate Charles Leclerc to "back the f*** off" before their "completely unacceptable" collision at the Las Vegas Grand Prix engulfed Ferrari in another crisis.

Leclerc was penalized with a 10-second sanction after the stewards deemed him "wholly responsible" for spinning Hamilton around following a moment of madness by the Monegasque with just 12 laps remaining. Hamilton finished seventh, with Leclerc 10th.

The collision marks the latest remarkable chapter between the warring team-mates, a fortnight after they staged a clear-the-air summit in São Paulo. That was in response to a first-lap squabble between Hamilton and Leclerc which cleared the way for Max Verstappen to win.

Prior to their accident here, Hamilton had already expressed his unease with Leclerc's driving.

"Charles is just… can you tell him to back the f*** off," said Hamilton over the radio. "I am trying to catch the guys ahead."

Leclerc was also making his feelings known to the Ferrari pit-wall: "He (Hamilton) needs to be careful with the squeezing, because it's not going to end well."

Hamilton then dropped from eighth to 14th after he was punished with a 10-second penalty for running off the track to overtake Lando Norris.

"Oh, that is bulls***," said Hamilton. "If I turned in(to Norris), I would have crashed. That's unbelievable, absolutely incredible."

Hamilton fought back and was duelling with Norris again, and his McLaren team-mate Oscar Piastri, when Leclerc attempted a reckless lunge on his team-mate for sixth.

Speaking to Leclerc after the chequered flag fell, Ferrari boss Fred Vasseur said: "Charles, I want to see you at the end of the race, before anything else."

Pressed on how the discussions with his driver went, Vasseur said: "It was not a discussion.

"I spoke. He apologized, he understood, but the result is there. You make a mistake and you say, 'it is my mistake and I am sorry', but you (still) made a mistake.

"It's completely unacceptable. It shows a lack of respect for the team, the sponsors, and it is the same speech as we had after Mexico. Today, it wasn't professional, and it is probably the escalation of tension."

Speaking in the lead up to Saturday's fixture, Hamilton insisted he and Leclerc were both on the same page.

But asked where they now go from here, the seven-time world champion replied: "It is not something I want to get into. That is a question for Ferrari. I've done all I can and I've said everything and more.

"It's been difficult. But all I can do is just show up and give it everything I can and hopefully in the background they will eventually figure it out.

"We were just thrown with a lot of challenges today. I kept my head down. The 10-second penalty was insane and very harsh. They could have just told me to give the position back (to Norris).

"I got back in it and thought we could fight for a podium. I was literally only thinking about battling McLaren. It's cost us a lot of points. The team deserves better."

Leclerc said: "I'll accept the blame for whatever comes with this incident because I received the penalty. I feel quite embarrassed for the team. I will review what happened."

articles.title: Shabana Azmi shares throwback video of Shankar Mahadevan and Sonu Nigam performing at her home with Sridevi and Satish Kaushik in the audience; writes, 'The absolute joy of having the best in the music world'
articles.summary: Shabana Azmi treated fans to a nostalgic glimpse of a star-studded musical soirée at her home, sharing an old video on Instagram.
articles.body: Shabana Azmi treated fans to a nostalgic glimpse of a star-studded musical soirée at her home, sharing an old video on Instagram. The clip, from a party hosted by her and Javed Akhtar, captures celebrity guests grooving to performances by Shankar Mahadevan, Sonu Nigam and others. Fans couldn't help but gush on spotting the late Sridevi and Satish Kaushik among the attendees.What Shabana Azmi wrote with the videoSharing the video on Instagram, Shabana wrote, “The absolute joy of having the best in the music world regale us at our home,” adding folded-hands emojis. The clip opens with Urmila Matondkar, Sunita Kapoor and others seated on a couch, facing the musicians. Sonu smiles as he plays a percussion instrument, while Raju Singh strums the guitar and Shankar prepares to sing. Boney Kapoor and Sridevi sit behind them, with Satish on a neighbouring couch. As Shankar begins Mitwa from Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna, guests take out their phones to record him. Several other celebrities can be spotted in the background.Fans react to Shabana Azmi's videoReacting to the clip, one user commented, “It's an old video satish kaushik is sitting there and if I'm not wrong he died 3 years back,” while another noted, “Even Alka Yagnik standing looks good in good health compared to the present.” A fan also pointed out, “Sridevi can be seen with Boney on sofa at the backside...don't miss,” and someone else wrote, “Old one, but good to see it again.” Several viewers who assumed the video was recent were puzzled to see Satish and Sridevi, saying they had to rewatch it multiple times. “Didn’t realise it’s an old video until I saw Sridevi sitting with Boney Kapoor,” read one comment.When was Shabana Azmi's video filmed?The clip appears to have been filmed at Javed's 72nd birthday celebration in 2017, when the couple invited friends to a party at their Juhu residence. Sridevi passed away at 54 in Dubai after accidentally drowning in a bathtub, while Satish died of a cardiac arrest in 2023 at the age of 66.Shabana Azmi's work frontThis year, Shabana appeared in Rajkumar Santoshi's 'Batwara 1947' and Nitin Kakkar's 'Awarapan 2'. 'Batwara 1947', which features Sunny Deol and Preity Zinta in the lead, drew lukewarm reviews and collected Rs 54.20 crore worldwide. 'Awarapan 2', headlined by Emraan Hashmi and Disha Patani, received mixed reviews and earned Rs 213 crore globally.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: In 2025, Tom Hanks’ son, Chet Hanks, moved to Nashville for his music; now the Hollywood star and singer has adopted the trailer park lifestyle in Nashville
articles.summary: Chet Hanks, son of Tom Hanks, has traded Hollywood glamour for a trailer park lifestyle in Nashville, where he finds joy in simplicity and music. Discover his journey from luxury to lakeside living.
articles.body: Did you know that Tom Hanks’ son, Chet Hanks, has strayed away from the Hollywood life? While he comes from a showbiz lineage, he has fully embraced the trailer park life with his dog. According to the latest reports, the musician and actor now stays in a Jayco Eagle RV, which is parked in a lakeside Nashville trailer park.About Chet Hanks’ trailer lifestyleRather than growing up in the Hollywood industry and investing in a luxury condo or renting a high-end apartment in Music City, Hanks purchased a Jayco Eagle travel trailer. While he joked that he hasn't splurged on an Airstream yet: "I'm not there yet," he praised his Jayco Eagle for having everything he needs. He has boasted that the trailer has a full kitchen and a separate walk-in shower, among many other features.While he does own his first ever property in Los Angeles, he soon realizes that the condo lifestyle is just not for him. While talking about living in a trailer on ‘The Tonight Show with Jimmy Fallon,' the star commented that he did not want to buy a new place and decorate it all over again when he moved to Tennessee. He commented, "I didn’t want to get an apartment. I was staying in Airbnbs and hotels, and that gets really old because I just like having my own space.”As to how he got inspired to live in a trailer instead of a big apartment? The star revealed that it was a road trip to Carmenl that made him realize that the trailer park life was for him. “I really loved it. And I was like, man, I want one of these.” He revealed that he lived in a trailer for the entirety of the trip and simply fell in love with it all. While talking about his home on wheels, Hanks further commented on how grateful he was that his RV did not have a ‘wet bath,' adding, "Sometimes they combine the toilet and the shower. It’s called a wet bath.”Chet Hanks is the youngest person in his trailer parkDuring the interview, he also revealed that he has a fire pit outside his RV and that he is possibly one of the youngest residents of the trailer park where he stays at. “I’m probably, like, the youngest person in the trailer park by like 30 or 40 years. It’s all just retirees, great people.”He then provided some comments on what he does in his trailer most of the time, where he stays with his dog. He added, “Most of the time, I just do exactly what I do at home, which is just stay inside and lie in bed and watch Netflix and things like that.” Since March of this year, Chet has also started sharing photos and videos on his Instagram as well, sharing glimpses of how his life is in the trailer park, the kind of views he wakes up to everyday and how he likes to have fun.On the work front, he releases songs with his country duo called Something Out West. When he first posted a teaser of one of his latest songs, the actor shared it along with the caption “Do you think my parents are proud of me for making this song, or am I cooked?” To this, his mother, Rita Wilson, quickly went into the comment section, writing, “This gets the Mama Seal of Approval.”Between recurring roles on Netflix's ‘Running Point’ and taking the stage at Stagecoach with his dad cheering from the crowd, Chet Hanks has been quite busy for the past couple of months. Not only that, but he has fully embraced his lakeside life in a trailer park surrounded by retired people. As of now, he has not expressed any interest in moving back into a house anytime soon.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Robert Pattinson becomes seventh actor to play James Bond in franchise's 60-year history
articles.summary: Robert Pattinson becomes the seventh James Bond, joining a legacy from Sean Connery's 1962 "Dr. No" to Daniel Craig's 2021 "No Time to Die."
articles.body: Robert Pattinson officially stepped into cinema’s most famous tuxedo as the seventh actor to play James Bond, joining a group of Hollywood legends who defined 007 for generations. The casting marks the latest chapter in a more than 60-year cinema legacy that began with Sean Connery in 1962 and most recently saw Daniel Craig retire the tuxedo in 2021's "No Time to Die." Before Pattinson takes his first sip of a shaken martini, we are looking back at every actor who previously held the iconic license to kill — from the modern-day action stars to the original 1960s trailblazers. ROBERT PATTINSON NAMED NEXT JAMES BOND Daniel Craig (2006-2021) Daniel Craig took over as James Bond in "Casino Royale" in 2006, delivering one of the franchise's most dramatic reinventions. The English actor's casting initially sparked debate among the spy's fans, but his intense physical performance and emotionally layered portrayal helped establish a new direction for the iconic spy. Craig starred in five Bond films: "Casino Royale," "Quantum of Solace," "Skyfall," "Spectre" and "No Time to Die." His version of Bond was more vulnerable and psychologically complex, with an interconnected storyline exploring the character's relationships, personal losses and loyalty to MI6. Craig concluded his 15-year run with "No Time to Die," marking one of the most consequential endings in the franchise's history. Pierce Brosnan (1995-2002) Pierce Brosnan became James Bond in 1995 with the release of "GoldenEye." The Irish actor helped introduce the legendary spy to a new generation of moviegoers. Along with "GoldenEye," Brosnan starred in "Tomorrow Never Dies," "The World Is Not Enough" and "Die Another Day." Following his departure from the franchise, Brosnan continued his Hollywood career with projects including "Mamma Mia!," "The Ghost Writer" and "Black Adam." The Welsh actor brought a darker and more serious tone to the franchise. Dalton developed his acting career through theater, television and film before becoming 007. Dalton appeared in two Bond films, "The Living Daylights," and "Licence to Kill." His portrayal moved away from the humor associated with Roger Moore and focused more heavily on espionage, revenge and realistic action. Roger Moore (1973-1985) Roger Moore took over the role in 1973 with the premiere of "Live and Let Die." The British actor brought a lighter, more humorous approach to the spy, differing from Connery's original tougher interpretation. Moore portrayed Bond in seven films, more than any other actor in the franchise. In addition to "Live and Let Die," he starred in "The Man with the Golden Gun," "The Spy Who Loved Me," "Moonraker," "For Your Eyes Only" and "Octopussy" His final appearance as Bond came with "A View to a Kill" in 1985. The Australian actor appeared in "On Her Majesty's Secret Service." At 29 when the film premiered, he became the youngest actor to portray Bond in the official film franchise. Lazenby's portrayal of Bond focused more on his romantic side, particularly through Bond's relationship with Tracy di Vicenzo. Although the film received mixed reviews upon release, it has since developed a strong following among Bond fans. Lazenby chose not to return for another installment, making him the only actor to portray Bond in just one official film. The Scottish actor helped turn Ian Fleming's fictional British spy into Hollywood's most recognizable action star. Connery starred in six official Bond films, including "From Russia with Love," "Goldfinger," "Thunderball," "You Only Live Twice" and "Diamonds Are Forever." articles.title: “90 Day Fiancé” Star Sheila Mangubat Dies at 35, Days Before Her Birthday
articles.summary: The reality star’s death was announced by her former fiancé, David Dangerfield
articles.body:
90 Day Fiancé star Sheila Mangubat has died at age 35

Her former fiancé, David Dangerfield, confirmed her death in an Instagram post

Mangubat and David appeared on 90 Day Fiancé: Before the 90 Days in 2023

90 Day Fiancé star Sheila Mangubat has died. She was 35.

Mangubat's former fiancé, David Dangerfield , announced her death in an Instagram post on Saturday, Nov. 21. She died days before her 36th birthday, TMZ reported.

"It breaks my heart to share the news from her family that Sheila passed away on Saturday in the Philippines," Dangerfield wrote.

"I am devastated and still trying to process this loss. Please keep her son, her family, and me in your prayers," he added. "Thank you for all your love and support."

According to TMZ, Mangubat's brother Jonathan posted a video of her funeral online on Sunday, Nov. 22. He also shared footage of her family at her deathbed the day before, the outlet reported.

Mangubat's sister Grace wrote in a tribute on Facebook , "Rest in peace my beloved sister, Shiela Mangubat ... fly high my sister, we will miss you."

Mangubat is from Cebu, Philippines. She met Dangerfield, 45, in a Facebook group for deaf singles in 2021, and they had a long-distance romance before getting engaged.

The pair documented their relationship and engagement on season six of TLC's 90 Day Fiancé: Before the 90 Days in 2023.

articles.title: Robert Pattinson owns a $5.3 million Hollywood Hills mansion but lives in rental homes with Suki Waterhouse; actor has a $3 million mortgage with monthly payments estimated at $13,500
articles.summary: Robert Pattinson may be preparing to take on one of Hollywood's most iconic roles as the next James Bond, but his personal life is far from settled.
articles.body: Robert Pattinson may be preparing to take on one of Hollywood's most iconic roles as the next James Bond, but his personal life is far from settled. The actor, who owns a multimillion-dollar mansion in Los Angeles with his fiancée Suki Waterhouse, is reportedly not living in the property. Instead, the couple and their young daughter have been moving between rental homes as their professional commitments take them across different cities.Newly reported property records have shed light on the $5.3 million Hollywood Hills home, including a $3 million mortgage reportedly linked to the purchase. According to OK! Magazine, the loan was taken out through a trust with City National Bank in 2022 and is scheduled to run until 2052. The estimated monthly payments are around $13,500.The revelation comes shortly after Waterhouse spoke about the family's unsettled living arrangements, admitting that their busy schedules have made it difficult to establish a permanent home.Robert Pattinson's $5.3 million Hollywood Hills home and $3 million mortgageAccording to OK! Magazine, property records show that Pattinson has a $3 million mortgage on the Hollywood Hills property he purchased with Waterhouse. The couple reportedly paid $5.3 million for the Spanish Colonial Revival-style house.The loan, which was reportedly arranged through a trust with City National Bank in 2022, is scheduled to run until 2052. Pattinson, who is currently 40, would be 66 when the mortgage reaches its scheduled end date.The publication estimates that the monthly mortgage payments are approximately $13,500. Based on those projections, the total interest over the life of the loan could amount to nearly $1.9 million.However, the reported mortgage should not be mistaken for an indication of financial trouble. Pattinson has built a successful career through major film franchises and independent projects, and his latest reported casting as James Bond could bring another significant payday.Why Robert Pattinson and Suki Waterhouse are living in rental homesDespite owning the Hollywood Hills mansion, Pattinson and Waterhouse have reportedly been staying in rented properties rather than making it their permanent family home.Waterhouse recently discussed their unusual living arrangements in an interview with The Sunday Times in November. The singer and actor explained that their professional commitments have made it difficult for them to settle in one place."We've been in rentals and moving every couple of months and we just haven't been home," she said.The couple's work has taken them between Los Angeles, New York and London. According to the report, they have also rented properties in New Orleans and West London, with their latest Los Angeles base reportedly in Beverly Hills.Their arrangements have become particularly important since the arrival of their daughter in March 2024. Balancing work commitments and family life has meant finding temporary homes wherever their schedules take them.Inside Robert Pattinson and Suki Waterhouse's Hollywood Hills mansionPattinson and Waterhouse's property has an interesting history. According to Architectural Digest, the couple purchased a Spanish Colonial Revival-style home built in 1939, which previously belonged to musician Beck and his former wife, actress Marissa Ribisi.The former couple reportedly purchased the house for approximately $3.1 million in 2018 before selling it to Pattinson and Waterhouse.The three-bedroom property features three-and-a-half bathrooms, exposed wooden beams, vaulted ceilings and a spacious living area. Its outdoor spaces include a plunge pool, a spa and a paved terrace. Thick hedges and gated entrances also offer privacy.Despite its features and multimillion-dollar price tag, the mansion has reportedly not become the family's regular residence, with the couple continuing to move between temporary homes.Robert Pattinson's reported James Bond deal could bring a huge paydayThe property revelations have emerged shortly after reports about Pattinson's lucrative James Bond deal. The 40-year-old actor was reportedly announced as the new 007 on November 16, taking over the iconic role previously played by Daniel Craig.According to Puck News, Pattinson negotiated more favourable terms than some of the other actors reportedly considered for the part. While Josh O'Connor and Jack Lowden were said to have been asked to commit to four films, Pattinson reportedly secured a three-film agreement with higher compensation.The exact figures have not been officially disclosed. However, estimates cited by Celebrity Net Worth suggest that Pattinson could receive between $15 million and $20 million upfront for his first Bond film. His earnings could rise with subsequent instalments, potentially reaching $60 million to $80 million over the three-film run.If performance bonuses are included and the films perform well, his total earnings could reportedly reach between $80 million and $110 million.For comparison, Daniel Craig is estimated to have earned around $110 million throughout his time as James Bond, with his final outing, No Time to Die, reportedly bringing him approximately $50 million.Are Robert Pattinson and Suki Waterhouse married?Pattinson and Waterhouse have been together since 2018 and got engaged in 2023. They welcomed their daughter in March 2024, but have yet to get married.Waterhouse also addressed speculation about a secret wedding during her recent interview with The Sunday Times, making it clear that the couple had not tied the knot.She suggested that when they eventually decide to marry, they would prefer a grand celebration rather than a low-key ceremony."It would either be all or nothing," she said. "If we were going to go for it we'd have a massive party, blow it out."Waterhouse also indicated that a wedding was unlikely to take place before the end of 2026.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Sheherazaad’s Khudgarzi is gorgeous, ‘genre-chaotic’ South Asian folk
articles.summary: Khudgarzi, the debut LP from Sheherazaad, blends traditional Indian instruments with Western electronic flourishes and feminist narratives.
articles.body: Sheherazaad started making ripples in the music world a few years ago with her EP Qasr, which was produced by Grammy Award winner Arooj Aftab. Now she’s back with Khudgarzi, her reverb-drenched folk-noir debut LP that’s primarily sung in Urdu. The instrumentation on Khudgarzi draws on traditional South Asian music, including Carnatic and Hindustani styles, but also dabbles in Arabic folk traditions, as well as modern Western electronic music. Trip-hop flourishes and Spaghetti Western guitar brush up against tanbur and ghatam. Sheherazaad’s stunning voice sits atop dripping percussion and seasick drones singing about the plight of “The Selfish Woman.” [Media: For Sheherazaad, the character of the selfish woman isn’t the villain, it’s a charge leveled at women who didn’t conform to societal norms, “eccentric women whose desire for agency was often met with an awful end.” Even if you can’t understand most of the lyrics, the atmosphere tells the story clearly enough. From the barely simmering anger of “Registaan” to the bleak repetition of “Qatil” and the fantastical yearning of “Zeher,” Khudgarzi is clearly the work of a woman exploring what it means to be a woman, the lasting legacy of colonialism, and the perpetual threats of a patriarchal society. [Media: Khudgarzi is alternately a funeral dirge and a celebration of femininity. Sheherazaad owes a lot of the album’s ability to navigate these various themes and moods to her impressive production work, top-notch mixing by J. Valleau, and the cast of over 30 “genre-chaotic” virtuosic musicians including Ria Modak, Sarathy Korwar, Jay Chakravorty, Shunya, and Qasim Naqvi. The instrumentation never distracts, though. It’s not showy, and all emulsifies around Sheherazaad’s vocals in a shawl that feels equal parts comforting and oppressive. articles.title: ‘Dukes of Hazzard’ star Catherine Bach says co-star stripped naked except for cowboy hat to cheer her up
articles.summary: Catherine Bach recalls James Best's hilarious naked prank on the "Dukes of Hazzard" set that lifted her homesickness, ending with 30 crew members bowing to him.
articles.body: "Dukes of Hazzard" star Catherine Bach recalled a wild behind-the-scenes prank that her co-star, James Best, pulled on her while they were filming the iconic 1980s sitcom. The 72-year-old actress recently spoke with Fox News Digital at Cure Addiction Now's third annual Fundraising Evening at the Beverly Hills Hotel, which raised money for research into treatments for substance-use disorder. During her interview alongside her daughter, Laura Lopez, Bach revealed that Best, who played Sheriff Rosco P. Coltrane on the show, stripped down naked to cheer her up when she was struggling with homesickness on the "Dukes of Hazzard" set. ‘DUKES OF HAZZARD’ STAR CATHERINE BACH STUNS FANS IN NEW PHOTO AFTER REPORTED HOSPITALIZATION "I was a little depressed," Bach remembered. "I was so far away from home. I'm in Georgia and it's all guys." However, Bach said her spirits were lifted after Best enlisted the help of a makeup artist for an outrageous stunt, which unfolded during what appeared to be a routine touch-up. "He has the makeup man. He goes, ‘Catherine, we need to get the makeup underneath your eyes. We need to straighten it out,'" Bach recalled. "And I said, ‘OK.' Close my eyes. He goes, ‘No, open your eyes so I can get underneath,' and I was like, ’What are you talking about?' So he goes, ‘Just look at my hat.' And I say, OK.’" ‘LITTLE HOUSE ON THE PRAIRIE’ STAR SAYS BRUTAL FILMING CONDITIONS LEFT CAST MEMBERS UNCONSCIOUS "And there's Jimmy, naked, except for his cowboy hat and his holster and guns," Bach remembered with a laugh. WATCH: ‘DUKES OF HAZZARD’ STAR CATHERINE BACH SAYS CO-STAR PULLED NAKED PRANK TO CHEER HER UP According to the actress, her co-star received an enthusiastic reception from the men on set afterward. "So then, when he came to set, 30 people were waiting for him, and they all bowed down, all the guys," she said. "But he got a laugh out of me because I hadn't been laughing very much." "The Dukes of Hazzard" aired for seven seasons on CBS from 1979 to 1985 and initially filmed in Georgia before production moved to California. The action comedy series followed cousins Bo and Luke Duke, played by John Schneider and Tom Wopat, and their adventures in fictional Hazzard County. Bach played their cousin Daisy Duke, while Best's Sheriff Coltrane frequently found himself outmaneuvered by the Duke boys. The series was a major hit, drawing in as many as 20 million viewers per episode. By its third season, "The Dukes of Hazzard" had become the second-biggest show on TV, according to The Hollywood Reporter. "The Dukes of Hazzard" catapulted the cast to stardom, especially Bach, whose short shorts made her a sex symbol. The cast members also became genuinely close both on and off set, forming lifelong friendships that have lasted decades after the show ended. LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? While speaking with Fox News Digital, Bach shared how Best's sense of humor remains part of her memories of making the series. Asked to name the biggest troublemaker on set, Bach declined to limit the distinction to one cast member. "Everybody, everybody. Jimmy Best, he was hilarious," she said. The actress has previously said that practical jokes were a regular part of life on the "Dukes of Hazzard set." "We all became such a family; there were so many pranks," Bach told the audience at a 2025 Hollywood Museum event with Schneider and Wopat, according to Remind magazine. During her interview with Fox News Digital, Bach also recalled how Daisy's wardrobe became a defining part of the series. The character's denim cutoffs became so closely associated with her that the style became widely known as "Daisy Dukes." During her time on the show, Bach posed as Daisy Dukes for a poster that sold five million copies, and her legs were insured for $1 million. The actress said she had a hands-on role in creating the clothes audiences saw onscreen, saying that she "made them all," including the Daisy Dukes. "And the bathing suit and the shirt," she added. ‘DUKES OF HAZZARD’ STAR JOHN SCHNEIDER BREAKS SILENCE ON EX-WIFE'S COURT BATTLE: 'EVERYTHING'S A NEGOTIATION' Bach explained that her sewing skills came from her mother's insistence that she learn a practical skill alongside pursuing acting. "My mother said I needed to have a craft in case I didn't make it as an actress," she said. Bach previously discussed her influence over her character's costume choices in a 2019 interview with Fox News Digital. She said producers initially wanted her to wear a poodle skirt, but she suggested the denim shorts that became a fashion sensation. However, Bach shared that the Daisy Dukes presented a familiar problem when it came time to put them on, saying that "gaining weight" in between seasons was "impossible." "Every year I would say, 'Wait a minute, you guys wash these in the washing machine, and you dried them, I know it. You're supposed to dry-clean them,'" she recalled. "They said, ‘No, we did, we do.’ I said, 'No, you didn't. See, I can't zip them up.'" "It might be me," she admitted with a laugh. The famed Daisy Dukes are not the only pieces of "Dukes of Hazzard" that remain part of Bach's life. "I'm building a General Lee," she told Fox News Digital. "A Charger." The orange 1969 Dodge Charger nicknamed General Lee that was driven by Bo and Luke was a signature part of the series, appearing in the high-speed police car chases and long stunt jumps that helped define the show. "Anyhow, I got it, and it's been a continuation of charity events," Bach said. "It's at a college right now, and all the kids are working on it." articles.title: 'Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping' box office: Prequel opens to $120 million, the franchise's biggest debut since 2014
articles.summary: "The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping" opened to an estimated $120 million in the U.S. and Canada and $225 million worldwide. Here's how that ranks.
articles.body:
"The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping" opened to an estimated $120 million in U.S. and Canadian theaters this weekend, according to studio estimates published Sunday by Box Office Mojo . That is the biggest debut for the franchise in 12 years.

The Lionsgate prequel, which follows a young Haymitch Abernathy, played in 4,018 theaters and averaged $29,865 per location. It took in $56 million on Friday, including $21 million from preview screenings, then $36.3 million on Saturday and a projected $27.7 million on Sunday, The Numbers reported .

Overseas, the movie added an estimated $105 million, for a worldwide opening of $225 million. Its reported production budget is $150 million, according to The Numbers.

"Sunrise on the Reaping" had the fourth-biggest domestic opening of the six "Hunger Games" movies, according to Box Office Mojo data:

"The Hunger Games" (2012): $152.5 million

"Mockingjay — Part 1" (2014): $121.9 million

"Sunrise on the Reaping" (2026): $120 million

"Mockingjay — Part 2" (2015): $102.7 million

"The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes" (2023): $44.6 million

The new movie opened about 2.7 times higher than "Songbirds & Snakes," the previous prequel.

"Sunrise on the Reaping" accounted for about 72% of all ticket sales at U.S. and Canadian theaters this weekend, based on The Numbers' total of $165.7 million for all movies reporting.

"I Play Rocky," about Sylvester Stallone's fight to make the original "Rocky," finished second with $9.3 million after Amazon MGM Studios expanded it from 29 theaters to 2,477. "Ebenezer" fell 59.5% in its second weekend to $7.7 million, and "The Cat in the Hat" took fourth with $6.85 million.

In limited release, Neon's "Paper Tiger" made $336,000 in 28 theaters, an average of $12,000 per location.

The figures are studio estimates. Final numbers are due Monday.

articles.title: Calhanoglu forced off injured in Atalanta-Inter as Carnesecchi pulls out in warm-up
articles.summary: Inter have been hit by an injury to Hakan Calhanoglu. The Turkish midfielder was forced off in the first half of Sunday night’s Serie A clash with Atalanta i...
articles.body:
Inter have been hit by an injury to Hakan Calhanoglu. The Turkish midfielder was forced off in the first half of Sunday night's Serie A clash with Atalanta in Bergamo.

According to SOS Fanta , the Turkish midfielder stopped and immediately asked to be substituted. The problem is muscular, in the flexor of his right thigh, and updates on his condition and recovery time will follow after tests in the coming hours.

Petar Sučić replaced him in the 34th minute, a minute after Francesco Pio Esposito headed in his second goal of the night to make it 2-0 to the Nerazzurri.

BERGAMO, ITALY – NOVEMBER 22: Head Coach of FC Internazionale Cristian Chivu looks on ahead the Serie A match between Atalanta BC and FC Internazionale at New Balance Arena on November 22, 2026 in Bergamo, Italy. (Photo by Antonino Lagana/Getty Images)

Calhanoglu had been one of Inter's liveliest players before going off. He almost scored in the third minute, but his shot was deflected behind for a corner by Sead Kolašinac.

The timing is bad for Cristian Chivu as Inter host VfB Stuttgart in the Champions League on Wednesday at 21:00 CET [20:00 GMT], then welcome Genoa to San Siro on Saturday. Piotr Zieliński is already listed as doubtful, which leaves Chivu short of experienced options in midfield.

ITALY – OCTOBER 18: Marco Carnesecchi of Atalanta BC gives instructions during the Serie A match between AC Milan and Atalanta BC at Stadio Giuseppe Meazza on October 18, 2026 in Italy. (Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images)

Atalanta had their own fitness problem before kick-off. Marco Carnesecchi suffered a knee problem during the warm-up and had to withdraw, despite being named in the starting line-up. Marco Sportiello took his place in Maurizio Sarri's XI. Like Calhanoglu, Carnesecchi will undergo further tests to establish the extent of the injury and how long he will be out.
